telegram-code.scope: Reviewed Telegram AI code and required static configuration under telegram-ai; no logs or caches

telegram-state.scope: Owner-approved application SQLite state; each SQLite DB backed up using SQLite online backup, not raw WAL copies

xray-config.scope: Reviewed etc/xray configuration and custom scripts

mcp-agents.scope: Reviewed local bridge and monitoring code; do not capture authentication material implicitly

entware-config.scope: Reviewed Entware custom configuration and separately generated package manifest

startup-cron.scope: Reviewed startup, watchdog, cron and custom networking scripts; no activation on restore

ha-integration.scope: Reviewed HA integration source on Keenetic, if present; not HA OS or /config on Raspberry Pi

notes: Candidate policy only, not a deployable allowlist. Actual per-file list, sensitive-state authorization, package manifest and large-file recovery plan must be reviewed locally. Reinstall architecture-specific packages; do not run MIPS software on ARM. Never export secrets through chat, GitHub or library. No implicit inclusion of authentication files.
